options.text: Reuse the image already on the machine as it is. It was built from `.devcontainer/Dockerfile`, which is the image the skill names, and reusing it means the run creates no new image that it would have to remove at the end.

Build a new image from `.devcontainer/Dockerfile`, using `git archive` of the bundled trunk commit as the build context, so it holds the toolchain that commit's `mise.toml` and `mise.lock` pin. Run the trials in that image, name the commit in the brief's Measured section as the one the image was built at, and remove the image at the end because it was not in the first listing.

Skip the dev container image. Run the trials in a slim official Node image pinned to the Node version `mise.toml` names, and install the candidate there at its pinned version, because that starts sooner than a full image build.
